title: Cross-Component Same-Symbol Signal State

research_height.transfer_path: A passed native signal inherits the latest passed direction on the same symbol from another component; that meso cross-strategy state is followed down to one admitted lifecycle and up only to the existing portfolio admission-to-birth transmission. No lot, slot or total-risk policy is inferred.

selection_card.central_question: When the latest passed signal on the same symbol came from a different strategy component, does direction persistence versus reversal identify a materially and broadly different state in candidate-to-birth transmission and final stressed lifecycle value?
bundle_lenses: cross-component same-symbol persistence versus reversal mechanism
component-adjusted final stressed-R and stop separation with a same-component US100 natural control
selection_card.current_bottleneck: The portfolio has complete native opportunities but no proven causal selector for which cross-strategy same-symbol context changes realized value. The verified logger is the first frozen evidence that preserves prior same-symbol component identity at the candidate and links it exactly to durable births and closes.
selection_card.why_now: The recent durable sequence is Programs 1, 5, 7, 3, 4 and 2 across macro, meso and micro heights. Program 1 is selected now because a new cross-component data role is dense across all six strategies and both natural symbols, not to complete a round. Program 2 Unit 058 is closed invalid and is not repaired or rescued.
selection_card.connection_bridge: This connects the user's US30 prior-signal persistence/reversal axis, US30-US100 strategy interaction, passed-but-blocked candidate funnel and actual portfolio admission path. It uses the newly frozen candidate-to-lifecycle bridge rather than another bar pattern or current-direction split.
selection_card.difference_from_recent_work: Unit 048 used the immediately prior signal from the same component across four periods and never knew which other strategy last spoke on the symbol. Unit 059 uses P4 logger rows whose prior_signal_component is explicitly different from the current component, includes blocked and unfilled passed candidates before birth, and then links only durable births to final lifecycle economics. Unit 058 used scheduled-event timing and no lifecycle outcome; Unit 059 uses no event calendar.
selection_card.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one later independently declared multi-period observation question for this cross-component same-symbol state. Unit 059 itself selects no filter, priority, admission, size, lot, slot, exit, EA or Live behavior.
selection_card.decision_if_false: Discard cross-component same-symbol persistence/reversal as a candidate field and do not spend a later MQL or real-tick matrix on it.
targets: all P4 passed-signal OUTCOME rows whose signal_relation is PERSIST or REVERSE and whose prior_signal_component differs from component_id
their exact durable BIRTH and CLOSE rows when a lifecycle exists
same-component US100 Cross and Passive PERSIST versus REVERSE births only as a natural specificity control
excluded_scope: signal feature magnitude, current BUY or SELL subgroup and prior-current component pair search
time-gap, same-day, session, weekday, event or freshness threshold
RC4 SELL warning, profit memory, peer exit, risk heat, lot, slot or capital response
Unit 058 repair, FOMC rescue or adjacent scheduled-event work
automatic_followups_forbidden: prior-current strategy pair or single-strategy subset
current direction, signal magnitude, period or symbol rescue
admission threshold, priority, lot, slot, risk or sizing policy
entry, protection, management, exit, EA or Live change

whole_map_comparison.program_1: Selected at meso height. Unit 053 was a US500 D1 price-structure observer and Unit 048 was same-component signal memory. The new logger supplies a different cross-component same-symbol causal state, upstream transmission and exact lifecycle link.
whole_map_comparison.program_2: Unit 058 just closed invalid. Its calendar reconstruction, FOMC context and BLS windows cannot be repaired or replaced adjacently.
whole_map_comparison.program_3: Unit 056 is recent and excludes adjacent handoff, crowding, release and timing refinements. No independent order/session structure outranks the ready Program 1 state.
whole_map_comparison.program_4: Unit 057 is immediate and closes adjacent profit-memory, peer-exit and management work. The RC4 SELL warning role has only sixteen rows and is not forced into a sparse unit.
whole_map_comparison.program_5: Unit 054 is recent. Only fifteen passed candidates were blocked in the logger path, and a heat or capacity refinement would be adjacent to Units 056 and 058 without counterfactual outcomes for the blocked rows.
whole_map_comparison.program_7: Unit 055 is recent. Unit 058 invalidity does not by itself justify another reconstruction or scheduler audit, and Program 6 repair remains outside the Goal.
whole_map_comparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 plus micro, meso and macro. Do not open an adjacent signal-history, time-gap, strategy-pair, direction or admission successor.

candidate_ledger.record_role: P4 causal candidate, prior same-symbol signal identity, admission and pre-decision portfolio context

lifecycle_ledger.record_role: P4 durable birth, close and non-interfering lifecycle economics

data_roles.role: consumed exploratory mechanism and translation evidence only
data_roles.authority_limit: A pass retains one later multi-period observation question only. It cannot change portfolio admission, capital, lot, slot, risk, entry or management.

fixed_reconstruction.candidate_population: Use candidate stage=OUTCOME rows with signal_passed=1 and signal_relation exactly PERSIST or REVERSE. FIRST is context only.
fixed_reconstruction.latest_same_symbol_state: Use the logger's causal prior_signal_direction, prior_signal_component and prior_signal_bar exactly as recorded. The logger updates the latest same-symbol direction only after a passed signal. No time cutoff or freshness reinterpretation is allowed.
fixed_reconstruction.primary_scope: CROSS_COMPONENT when prior_signal_component is nonblank and differs exactly from component_id.

primary_roles.PERSIST: Current passed direction equals the latest passed direction on the same symbol from a different component.
primary_roles.REVERSE: Current passed direction is opposite the latest passed direction on the same symbol from a different component.

fixed_reconstruction.natural_control: SAME_COMPONENT_US100 uses only Cross and Passive rows whose prior_signal_component equals component_id. Same-component US30 lacks a usable reversal role and is context only.
fixed_reconstruction.candidate_to_birth_key: Exact CSV strings component_id + volume + stop_loss + planned_risk_usd + signal_relation. Every BIRTH must match exactly one candidate outcome and no candidate key may match more than one BIRTH.
fixed_reconstruction.birth_to_close_link: Link each matched BIRTH to exactly one CLOSE by exact position_identifier. BIRTH and CLOSE record_id values remain distinct row identities.

transmission_categories.POSITION_OPEN: Market order path completed and must map to a durable birth.
transmission_categories.PENDING_FILLED: PENDING_ORDER candidate maps to a later durable Passive birth.
transmission_categories.PENDING_EXPIRED: PENDING_ORDER candidate has no matching birth.
transmission_categories.BLOCKED: PRICE_DISTANCE_BLOCKED or PROTECTION_OR_RISK_BLOCKED and has no matching birth.

future_outcomes.final_stressed_r: CLOSE stressed_net_usd divided by the matched BIRTH positive planned_risk_usd.
future_outcomes.stop: CLOSE exit_class denotes a stop-loss exit rather than a native exit.
future_outcomes.actual_net_usd: CLOSE actual_net_usd, reported only and never used to rescue a stressed gate.

fixed_reconstruction.primary_component_adjustment: For each CROSS_COMPONENT PERSIST lifecycle, subtract the exact current-component CROSS_COMPONENT REVERSE mean for final stressed R, stop and positive. Average those residuals with equal PERSIST-lifecycle weight. Report raw component differences for breadth and contribution.
fixed_reconstruction.symbol_view: Repeat the PERSIST-target residual average separately for US30 and US100 using the same component comparator means.
fixed_reconstruction.natural_control_adjustment: For each SAME_COMPONENT_US100 PERSIST lifecycle, subtract the exact same current-component SAME_COMPONENT_US100 REVERSE mean. Cross and Passive are the only control components.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only immutable file identity, headers, candidate stage/result, signal relation, current/prior component, symbol, decision/prior bar, order geometry, BIRTH identity and structural candidate-to-birth and birth-to-close linkage were accessed. No CLOSE actual_net_usd, stressed_net_usd, exit_class, positive result, strategy-adjusted economic residual, gate or verdict was cast or aggregated.

fixed_reports.candidate_transmission: Report primary candidate, result, matched-birth, pending-fill, pending-expiration and blocked counts and rates by relation, current component and symbol.
fixed_reports.primary_economics: Report CROSS_COMPONENT PERSIST and REVERSE n, raw final stressed R, stop rate, positive rate and actual net by pooled, current component and symbol views.
fixed_reports.primary_adjusted: Report PERSIST minus component-REVERSE adjusted final stressed R, stop and positive residuals; raw component differences, symbol residuals and absolute R contribution shares.
fixed_reports.natural_control: Report SAME_COMPONENT_US100 Cross and Passive PERSIST versus REVERSE raw and component-adjusted final metrics. The control can veto cross-component specificity but cannot independently retain a same-component seed.
fixed_reports.context_only: Report FIRST and same-component US30 counts only. They cannot enter or rescue any gate.

fixed_integrity_gate: All three immutable inputs retain their exact byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes.
The candidate ledger has 48 columns, 4,043 rows, 4,043 unique record_id values and zero research_dropped_records.
Reproduce passed-signal OUTCOME relations FIRST/PERSIST/REVERSE 2/224/172 and scope-relation counts CROSS 159/131 and SAME 65/41.
Reproduce every primary result, translation, component, symbol and same-component US100 control count declared above.
The exact candidate-to-birth key yields 356 unique matches, 27 unmatched expired Passive pending orders, zero unmatched birth and zero ambiguity.
The lifecycle ledger has 60 columns, 841 rows, 841 unique record_id values, 356 unique births, 356 unique closes, exact 356-position overlap, zero partial row and zero dropped-record row.
Every judged birth has one exact later CLOSE, positive finite planned risk and finite close metrics; no judged role, component or symbol is missing.
fixed_density_gate: Primary CROSS_COMPONENT candidate PERSIST and REVERSE reproduce exact counts 159 and 131 and each has at least 125 passed signals.
Primary linked PERSIST and REVERSE births reproduce exact counts 145 and 112 and each has at least 100 lifecycles.
Every primary current-component relation cell has at least seven linked lifecycles and every symbol relation cell at least forty.
The SAME_COMPONENT_US100 control reproduces 39/35 linked births; Cross and Passive each have at least eight births in both roles.
fixed_primary_economic_gate: Absolute pooled component-adjusted PERSIST-minus-REVERSE final stressed-R residual is at least 0.10R.
Absolute pooled component-adjusted PERSIST-minus-REVERSE stop residual is at least 0.05.
Final stressed-R and stop residual signs are nonzero and economically opposite.
Raw final stressed-R and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least four of six current components.
Adjusted final stressed-R and stop residuals each share their pooled sign in both US30 and US100 views.
No current component contributes more than 45 percent and no symbol more than 70 percent of the absolute primary final stressed-R residual numerator.

fixed_specificity_control.same_direction_material_control: The natural control is material in the same direction only when its absolute component-adjusted final stressed-R residual is at least 0.10R, its absolute stop residual is at least 0.05, the two control channels are economically opposite, and both control signs equal the primary signs.
fixed_specificity_control.veto: A same-direction material SAME_COMPONENT_US100 control vetoes a cross-component-specific seed. It is reported as a general same-symbol state but cannot reopen Unit 048 or retain an adjacent same-component question.
fixed_specificity_control.pass: The cross-component specificity control passes when the same-direction material-control condition is false.

fixed_bundle_gate.success: PASS_CROSS_COMPONENT_SAME_SYMBOL_SIGNAL_STATE_MULTI_PERIOD_OBSERVATION_QUESTION when integrity, density, the complete primary economic gate and the specificity control all pass.
fixed_bundle_gate.material_not_specific: MATERIAL_BUT_NOT_CROSS_COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_NO_SEED when integrity, density and the primary economic gate pass but the same-direction material natural control vetoes specificity.
fixed_bundle_gate.failure: NO_CROSS_COMPONENT_SAME_SYMBOL_SIGNAL_STATE_PASSED when integrity and density pass but the primary economic gate fails.
fixed_bundle_gate.invalid: INVALID_CANDIDATE_LIFECYCLE_OR_SIGNAL_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any immutable input, row, relation, scope, join, topology, finite-value or density integrity fails.
fixed_bundle_gate.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_CROSS_COMPONENT_SAME_SYMBOL_SIGNAL_STATE_NO_SEED only when integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition blocks the frozen interpretation without changing it.
fixed_bundle_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one independently named later multi-period observation question after a fresh whole-map comparison. No policy or implementation opens in Unit 059.
fixed_bundle_gate.nonpassing_action: Retain no cross-component same-symbol signal-state seed and preserve all frozen entry and admission behavior.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before casting or aggregating any matched CLOSE actual_net_usd, stressed_net_usd, exit_class, positive result, adjusted residual, contribution, gate or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the two immutable ledgers.
Do not change the cross-component definition, relation state, exact join, component adjustment, natural control, metrics, thresholds, breadth or concentration gates.
Do not add elapsed-time or same-day windows, prior-current strategy pairs, current direction, signal magnitude, event, session, period, strategy or symbol subgroup rescue.
Do not convert blocked candidates into counterfactual outcomes, run standalone EAs, infer lot or slot value, or select an admission response.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, retain a CLI, inspect Program 6, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and recompare the whole program-and-height map without an adjacent Program 1 successor.
